rows.Business objective: Coordinate legally approved closing, allotment evidence and statutory obligations

rows.Workflow steps:
1. Validate required evidence and amounts; detect missing legal gates; hold unready cases
2. Validate current approvals; record closing evidence and authorized allotment reference; prevent duplicate transition
3. Generate filing task list and report draft; assign owner and deadline; require legal verification
4. Resolve dependencies; monitor dates; escalate missing evidence; prevent premature close

rows.AI agent responsibilities: Policy review; document intelligence

rows.Human approval requirements: Mandatory legal and finance approval; no unapproved allotment or filing

rows.Related database entities: inv_allotment; inv_cap_table_event; inv_closing; inv_closing_requirement; inv_filing_task; inv_legal_check; inv_obligation
rows.Open-source software requirements: Python; Django REST Framework; PostgreSQL; Celery / Beat; Valkey; decimal arithmetic and atomic PostgreSQL transactions
rows.External provider requirements: Legal advisers and authorized filing systems; manual filing where no provider access
rows.Estimated execution cost: See Cost Model: scenario-only internal INR per workflow invocation; provider fees, retry, storage and human labor excluded. Pricing TBD.
rows.Subscription pricing model: Proposed monthly base entitlement + metered excess per closing case; annual option; provider charges/managed service separately quoted. Price TBD.
rows.Usage limits: Illustrative pilot: 30 closing case(s)/month; 1 concurrent run; configurable hard budget, provider quota and frequency limits. Not approved.
rows.Full / partial / selective availability: Full suite / Closing & Investor Lifecycle bundle / selective (1 SKU); entitlement and usage approval required.
